create_engine_hidden_states: create an sgl.Engine with enable_return_hidden_states to initialize a model that returns hidden states
generate_hidden_states: generate text completions with return_hidden_states to retrieve hidden states for each prompt
shutdown_engine: shutdown the sgl.Engine to release CUDA resources and terminate the model process
convert_hidden_states_tensor: convert hidden states from raw lists to torch tensors with bfloat16 dtype
cat_hidden_states: concatenate hidden state tensors along batch dimension using torch.cat for each output
